source: 558 Tamara Family
target: 558 Familia Tamara

source: 558 Tamara Family
target: 558 Familia Tamara

source: Lumian savored the tang of fermented grape juice bought from a street vendor as he coolly surveyed the suite rented by the adventurer, Louis Berry.
target: Lumian gustavit saporem succi uvae fermentatae, quem a venditore ambulanti empsit, dum aequo animo conclavum adventoris, Ludovicus Berry, speculabatur.

source: He occasionally cast a discerning eye over Aquina Street, on the lookout for any potential monitors.
target: Nonnumquam per viam Aquina oculos incisos misit, quaerens si quis potentialis monitor appareret.

source: A little over half an hour ago, Lumian had transformed his appearance and changed into a different outfit.
target: Paulo plus quam dimidiā hora abhinc, Lumian speciem suam transformaverat et vestem diversam induerat.

source: He had seemingly “teleported” to a nearby street before returning to secure a suitable room.
target: Videnter “teleportatus” est in viam propinquam perveniens, antequam rediret ad conclavum aptum obtinendum.

source: Soon enough, Lumian spotted Lugano cautiously heading out to fetch an extra breakfast for Ludwig.
target: Cito, Lumian animadvertit Lugano cautissime exiens ad extra ientaculum pro Ludovico petendum.

source: A chuckle escaped him.
target: Risus effugit eum.

source: This guy was still spooked from yesterday’s attack.
target: Hic vir adhuc ex impetu heri territus erat.

source: However, unless the members of the Fisheries Guild had succumbed to the corrupting influence of superpowers, losing control of their emotions and rational thinking, it was improbable for them to target Lugano, the interpreter and guide.
target: Nisi sodales Guildae Piscandi potentiarum corruptivarum influxui cederent, et temperamentum sensuum ac rationis amitterent, improbabile erat ut Lugano, interpretum et ducem, eligere conarentur.

source: Louis Berry’s response the previous day had sent a clear message to everyone:
target: Responsio Ludovicus Berry die praeterito omnibus perspicuum nuntium misit:

source: If you can’t take me out directly, keep your sights off those around me.
target: Si me directe occidere non potestis, oculos vestros a circumstantibus abstinete.

source: You might eliminate me, but I, Louis Berry, can do the same.
target: Me forte extinguere poteritis, sed ego, Ludovicus Berry, id eodem modo efficere possum.

source: There’ll come a time when your Fisheries Guild’s committee members, your kids, and descendants travel without protection or lack strength.
target: Tempus venerit quo sodales commissi Guildae Piscandi, liberi vestri atque posteri, sine tutela peregrinabunt aut virtute deficient.

source: Wanna guess if I’d dare to make a move or if I have the capability?
target: Velitisne coniectare an moveam an potentiam habeam?

source: Either find an opportunity to bring me down with all you’ve got, or play nice!
target: Aut occasionem invenite me omni viribus deicere, aut bene age!

source: Faced with such a resolute “answer,” the rational committee members of the Fisheries Guild would know what to do.
target: Responsione tam firma obviam, sodales rationis in commissis Guildae Piscandi scire debebant quid agendum esset.

source: Louis Berry, the adventurer, wasn’t bound by official rules like a Beyonder or a cop.
target: Ludovicus Berry, adventor, non officialibus regulis, ut Beyonder vel custos, obligatus erat.

source: Expecting him not to involve family in the game was unrealistic.
target: Exspectatio, ne familiam in ludo implicaretur, irrationabilis erat.

source: Moreover, considering his recent behavior and the circulating rumors, he was a daring adventurer, reminiscent of Gehrman Sparrow.
target: Praeterea, his rebus recentibus et rumoribus diffundentibus consideratis, audax adventor erat, similis Gehrman Sparrow.

source: Known for his aggression, madness, and coldness, there were no limits to what such a person might do.
target: Notus ob impetum, insaniam, et frigorem, nullae erant limites ad ea quae talis homo efficere poterat.

source: Of course, Lumian wasn’t letting his guard down entirely.
target: Certe, Lumian custodiam suam non penitus demisit.

source: Lugano would either have Ludwig’s “company” in the future, or he’d be under Lumian’s watchful eye at all times.
target: Lugano aut futurum erit particeps comitatus Ludovici, aut semper sub vigilantia Lumiani remanebit.

source: After all, beyond the Fisheries Guild, many individuals in Port Santa were secretly plotting to exploit this opportunity for their own gain.
target: Nihilominus, ultra Guildam Piscandi, multi in Porto Santa occulte machinabantur ut hanc occasionem pro utilitate sua exponerent.

source: Disguised as Fisheries Guild members, they could attack the interpreter and godson of the adventurer Louis Berry, intensifying the conflict and stirring up trouble prematurely.
target: Sub specie sodalium Guildae Piscandi, impetum facere poterant in interpretum atque filium adoptivum adventoris Ludovicus Berry, conflictum intensificantes et tumultum praecoquenter excitantes.

source: Ignoring conspiracies at this level would be unacceptable for a Conspirer.
target: Coniurationes huius gradus ignorare a Coniuratore inacceptabile erat.

source: After Lugano returned to his suite on the fifth floor of Solow Motel with a heap of breakfast, Lumian purposefully avoided looking at the high-backed chair, seemingly adorned with a golden straw hat, positioned strategically at the dining table.
target: Postquam Lugano cum multitudo ientaculi ad conclavum suum in quinto tabulato Solow Motel rediit, Lumian conscio animo vitavit introspectare sellam altum dorsu, quae videbatur ornata pileo aureo stramineo ad mensam prandii constitutam.

source: He turned on his heel and exited the room, ready to explore the surroundings.
target: Calcaneum verteret et conclavum reliquit, paratus ambitum explorare.

source: Stepping into the corridor, Lumian immediately spotted a burly man standing near the staircase, barely reaching 1.7 meters in height.
target: Ingrediens in corridorium, Lumian statim animadvertit virum robustum iuxta scalas stantem, vix altitudinem 1.7 metrorum attingentem.

source: The man, with brown hair, brown eyes, and rugged skin, held a distinctive long mouth cigarette between his lips, fixing his gaze on Lumian.
target: Vir, capillis fuscis, oculis fuscis, et cute rudi, cigarettam longam distinctivam inter labia tenebat, oculosque in Lumian fixos habebat.

source: In Highlander, the man inquired, “Who sent you here to keep an eye on Louis Berry?”
target: In lingua Highlander, vir rogavit: “Quis te huc misit ut Louis Berry inspicias?”

source: Lumian couldn’t help but let out a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian non potuit sed molliter subridere.

source: “Are you not here to monitor Louis Berry yourself?
target: “Nonne hic es ut ipse Louis Berry inspicias?

source: “I didn’t even inquire about your sender. Why the sudden curiosity?”
target: “Me quidem non interrogavi de mittente tuo; cur ista subito curiositas?”

source: He responded in flawless Highlander as well.
target: Ipse quoque in lingua Highlander perfecte respondit.

source: The man, with the long mouth cigarette dangling, contemplated for a moment before nodding in agreement, making way for the stairs.
target: Vir, cum cigaretta longam inter labia pendente, paulisper meditatus est antequam annuit consensu, viam ad scalas aperiens.

source: Lumian strolled past him, descending the staircase step by step.
target: Lumian praeter eum ambulavit, scalas gradatim descendens.

source: As he departed, the man’s gaze took on a gradually ominous edge.
target: Cum discesserit, oculus viri paulatim in minacem aciem vertit.

source: He raised his left hand, delicately twisting the special long mouth cigarette.
target: Manum sinistram attollens, subtiliter cigarettam longam peculiarem flexit.

source: Taking a deep breath, he exhaled into the cigarette, and in silence, a slender steel needle shot forth from the charred tobacco, aimed directly at Lumian’s back, mere two meters away.
target: Altum spiritum inspirans, in cigarettam effudit, et silentio, acus chalybea gracilis ex tabaco combusto proiecit, directe in tergum Lumian, a solis duorum metrorum distantem.

source: It was a blow dart, originating from certain tribes in the primitive forests of the Southern Continent.
target: Illa erat telum flatu, oriundum ex quibusdam tribubus in silvis primitivis Continentis Australis.

source: Typically, blow darts were one to two meters long, making them unsuitable for concealment or sneak attacks.
target: Typice, telina unius ad duorum metrorum longitudine erant, quod eas ad latentiam aut furtivas incursiones inhabiliter destinabat.

source: However, bounty hunters, followers of the God of Steam and Machinery with strong hands, modified them into a more portable version—only slightly longer than regular cigarettes.
target: Attamen, venatores praemiis, sequaces Dei Vaporis et Machinarum robustis manibus, ea in versionem magis portabilem mutaverunt—modo paulo longiores quam sigarettae vulgares.

source: While this modification increased portability and its concealed nature, it sacrificed some power and limited its range to a mere four to five meters.
target: Dum haec modificatio portabilitatem et occultationem augebat, aliquam potentiam sacrificavit et ambitum eius ad solum quattuor ad quinque metrorum restringebat.

source: When paired with specially crafted arrows carrying anesthetic and lethal toxins, it remained a favored tool among bounty hunters on both Northern and Southern Continents.
target: Cum sagittis specialiter confectis, quae anesthetica et toxina letalia ferrebant, instrumentum delectum inter venatores praemiis in Continente Septentrionali et Australi permanebat.

source: The man had concealed the blow dart within the long mouth cigarette, intending to lull the target and strike when the opportune moment arrived.
target: Vir telum flatu in cigaretta longa abscondit, propositum habens victimam soporem inducere et ictum inferre cum tempus opportunum advenerit.

source: His objective: to subdue Lumian and extract information about the identity of his employer.
target: Eius propositum: Lumian sedare et notitiam de identitate patroni sui extrahere.

source: The steel needle flashed past, but Lumian seemed to have anticipated the attack.
target: Acus chalybea praetercursit, sed Lumian videtur impetum praescivisse.

source: Just as the man blew air to propel the needle, Lumian swiftly bent forward, arched his spine, and dodged the blow dart in an almost inhuman contortion.
target: Dum vir aerem sufflavit ad acus proiciendam, Lumian celeriter se inclinavit, dorsum flexit, et telum flatu, fere inhumanam contortionem exsequens, evasit.

source: With a soft poof, the steel needle embedded itself into the wooden staircase.
target: Molli ‘poof’ sono, acus chalybea in scala lignea se insedit.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: He fainted.
target: Evanuit.

source: Swiftly recovering from his contorted evasion, Lumian bent down, scooped up the unconscious assailant, and dragged him into his rented room.
target: Celeriter a sua contorta evasione recuperatus, Lumian se inclinavit, aggressorem inanimatum sustulit, et in conclavum locatum traxit.

source: Taking advantage of the assailant’s unconscious state, Lumian administered a dose of truth serum and calculated the time for him to regain consciousness.
target: Ex inanimati status aggressoris usus, Lumian dosum serum veritatis administravit et tempus computavit quo ille ad conscientiam redeat.

source: Examining the unremarkable, ordinary face of his assailant, Lumian calmly listened to the panicked shout.
target: Inspectans faciem simplicem aggressoris, Lumian placide auscultavit clamoris pavidum.

source: “I just wanted to incapacitate you and find a spot to interrogate you about your employer!
target: “Tantum te incapacitare et locum invenire volui, ut de tuo patrono te interrogarem!

source: “The poison on the arrow is just an anesthetic!”
target: “Venenum in sagittā tantum anestheticum est!”

source: Squatting in front of the man, Lumian smiled and responded, “Now, let me ask you, who’s your employer?”
target: In genu coram viro prostratus, Lumian subridens respondit: “Nunc, permitte me quaerere: quis est patronus tuus?”

source: “It's Juan Oro!” the brown-haired, brown-eyed man blurted out.
target: “Est Juan Oro!” exclamavit vir capillis fuscis et oculis fuscis.

source: Lumian chuckled and probed further, “Is that so?”
target: Lumian subridens ulterius interrogavit: “Ita est?”

source: “Yes, no, it’s actually someone else…” At this point, horror overcame the man, and he fell silent.
target: “Ita, non, revera aliquis alius est…” Tum, horror viro intravit, et ille tacuit.

source: Lumian prompted him patiently.
target: Lumian eum patienter incitavit.

source: “Who is it?”
target: “Quis est?”

source: After struggling for a few seconds, the man involuntarily spoke,
target: Post paucas secundas luctationis, vir involuntarie locutus est,

source: “Rubió Paco.”
target: “Rubió Paco.”

source: Rubió… Why is he keeping tabs on me?
target: Rubió… Cur me perscrutatur?

source: Does he seek to gain from the adventurer’s activities?
target: Num ex operibus adventoris lucrum quaerit?

source: Is that why he didn’t approach me discreetly to share information?
target: Num idcirco tacite ad me non accessit, ut informationem communicaret?

source: Lumian nodded subtly and straightened up.
target: Lumian subtiliter annuit et se recte erexit.

source: “Your breath stinks. Remember to brush your teeth more often.”
target: “Spiritus tuus foetidus est. Memento dentes tuos pluries purgare.”

source: “…” The assailant looked perplexed, unable to fathom why the conversation had taken this turn.
target: “…” Aggressor perplexus videbatur, neque intellegere poterat cur sermo ita vertisset.

source: Nonetheless, he replied half-heartedly, “I'm not a fan of brushing my teeth.”
target: Attamen, respondit semidiligenter: “Non sum fautor dentes purgandi.”

source: Lumian shook his head in disdain, uninterested in the blow dart as a trophy.
target: Lumian caput in contemptu concussus est, non curo telum flatu ut trophaeum servare.

source: Leaving the room, he left a parting message: “Make sure to lock the door behind me.”
target: Ex conclavi egressus, nuntium valedictorium relinquit: “Cura ut ostium post me claudatur.”

source: In Trier, within Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Franca and Jenna’s rented apartment.
target: In Treveris, intra Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorativa, habitaculum Francae et Jennæ locatum erat.

source: They had already received Madam Judgment’s response via Rabbit Chasel.
target: Iamdudum acceperant responsum Dominae Judgment per Rabbit Chasel.

source: Before departing, Rabbit Chasel, adorned with a miniature top hat, shrunken gold-rimmed glasses, and a diminutive black trench coat, made an unusual request.
target: Ante discessum, Rabbit Chasel, parvo pileolo, oculis aureis parvis fusis, et nigro trench coat parvulo indutus, rogationem insolitam fecit.

source: “Can I use a custom-made revolver as compensation for delivering the next five letters?”
target: “Possumne revolverum specialiter confectum uti, ut praemium pro traditione quinque epistularum futurarum habeam?”

source: Jenna’s mouth hung open, momentarily taken aback.
target: Os Jennæ patebat, instante stupefactum.

source: “Sure.”
target: “Certe.”

source: She questioned, “Why can’t you conjure one yourself?”
target: Ea interrogavit: “Cur te ipse non potes unum creare?”

source: Similar to your top hat, glasses, and trench coat.
target: Sicut pileus tuus, oculi, et trench coat.

source: “They have no practical use, but I hope the revolver does. The bullets need to be custom-made too,” Rabbit Chasel explained earnestly.
target: “Non habent usum practicum, sed spero revolverum utile fore. Balistae quoque specialiter conficiendae sunt,” explicavit Rabbit Chasel studiose.

source: Jenna blinked and acquiesced.
target: Jennæ palpebravit et assentivit.

source: Once the messenger departed, Franca commented with a peculiar expression,
target: Postquam nuntius discessit, Franca cum vultu peculiario commentum fecit:

source: “Why does it feel like it has shifted from pursuing knowledge to pursuing strength?”
target: “Cur videtur studium translatum esse ex quaerenda scientia in quaerendam virtutem?”

source: Jenna wanted to defend Rabbit Chasel but struggled to find a compelling excuse.
target: Jennæ volebat Rabbit Chasel defendere, sed vix invenit rationem persuasivam.

source: Instead, she cursed, “It’s not necessarily a bad thing. It might even aid me in future battles!”
target: Pro eo, maledixit: “Non necessario res mala est. Fortasse etiam in futuris proeliis mihi auxilio erit!”

source: “Moreover, the stronger the messenger, the safer the letter deliveries.”
target: “Praeterea, quo fortior nuntius, eo tutiores traditio epistularum erit.”

source: Franca, lacking a messenger, suddenly felt a twinge of envy. Without delay, she unfolded Madam Judgment’s reply.
target: Franca, nuntiis carens, subito invidiam sensit. Statim responsum Dominae Judgment evolvit.

source: “The Tamara family, one of the five noble families from the Fourth Epoch’s Tudor Empire, held a hereditary duke aristocratic title, akin to the Amon you’re familiar with, albeit slightly lower in status.
target: “Familia Tamara, una ex quinque familiis nobilibus Imperii Tudoriani Quartae Aetatis, titulum ducalem hereditarium tenebat, similem Amon, quem nosti, licet statura paulo inferiori.

source: “In the era when the gods roamed the land, families capable of becoming great nobles undoubtedly possessed angelic powers. According to the information, the Tamara family had existed for many years before Alista Tudor became the Blood Emperor. They were renowned nobles from the previous empire.
target: In aetate, cum dii terram peragrabant, familiae, quae ad magnam nobilitatem idoneae erant, indubitanter vires angelicas habebant. Ex informationibus, familia Tamara per multos annos exstiterat antequam Alista Tudor Imperator Sanguinis factus est. Erant nobilitates praeclarae imperii priore.

source: “They had the coat of arms changed once and two internal divisions. This is why Tamara was buried on different levels of the catacombs at different times.
target: “Arma gentilis semel mutata sunt et duas divisiones internas constitutae; ideo familia Tamara in diversis gradibus catacumbarum, variis temporibus, sepulta erat.

source: “Initially, their coat of arms consisted of thorns, a shieldwall, and vertical swords. Later, it became an open door, with the vertical sword acting as the crack.
target: Initio, arma eorum constabant ex spinis, muro scuti, et gladiis verticalibus; postea, factum est ostium apertum, in quo gladius verticalis quasi hiatrum fungebatur.

source: “This represents a significant change in the Tamara family. It shifted from being dominated by the Justiciar pathway to being dominated by the Apprentice pathway. However, no corresponding historical information has appeared for the time being.
target: Hoc mutationem significantem in familia Tamara repraesentat. Ab itinere Iusticiar regendo ad viam Apprenticis dominantem transitum fecit; sed ad hunc tempore nulla notitia historica correspondens apparuit.

source: “A small number of members of the Tamara family, who adhere to the Judgment pathway, have survived to this day and are secretly active.
target: Parvus numerus membrorum familiae Tamara, qui viam Iudicii sequuntur, usque ad hunc diem supervixerunt et occulte agunt.

source: “The other Tamara group had established a close connection with the Demoness family during the Tudor Empire’s era. During the Fifth Epoch, a secret organization known as the Theosophy Order emerged. It had Demoness figures and originated from Tamara’s Apprentice pathway. There’s reason to believe that they are still cooperating.
target: Altera coetus Tamara tempore Imperii Tudoriani cum familia Demoness coniunctionem strictam constituit. In Quinta Aetate, ordo secretus nomine Ordo Theosophiae apparuit. Eorum figurae Demoness erant et ex via Apprenticis Tamara oriundi sunt; ratio est credendi eos adhuc cooperari.

source: “This Tamara group has been estranged from the other one for many years, refusing to acknowledge each other.
target: Hic coetus Tamara per multos annos ab altero alienatus est, recusans se invicem agnoscere.

source: “The Tamaras of the Judgment pathway also experienced a division. The exact situation is unknown…
target: Tamarae viae Iudicii quoque divisionem passae sunt; status exactus ignotus est…

source: Upon reading this, Franca and Jenna shared the same thought.
target: Hoc lecto, Franca et Jennæ eandem sententiam habuerunt.

source: The Tamara family is indeed connected to the Demonesses!
target: Familia Tamara certe cum Demonesses conexa est!

source: They continued reading the contents of the letter.
target: Continuerunt epistulae contenta legere.

source: “The person who led you to the Tamara family’s tomb and discovered the Mirror World Fragment is likely targeting that special mirror world and the Demoness Sect. Don’t worry for the time being. Just be vigilant against coincidences, theft, and scams around you…”
target: “Persona quae te ad sepulcrum familiae Tamara duxit et Fragmentum Mundi Speculi detexit, verisimiliter illud mundum speculi peculiare atque Sectam Demoness intendit. Interim ne solliciti sitis; tantum vigiletis contra casus, furtum, et scamas circa vos…

source: In the ensuing days, Lumian, along with Lugano and Ludwig, remained unharmed.
target: In diebus sequentes, Lumian una cum Lugano et Ludwig incolumis mansit.

source: Port Santa seemed to settle back into a semblance of normalcy. Those secretly observing displayed no indications of advancing further.
target: Portus Santa videbatur ad statum ordinarii redeuntem; qui occulte observabant, nullas indicia progressionis ostenderunt.

source: Just as Lumian contemplated taking further actions to elucidate all details before the sea prayer ritual in early November, the Knight of Swords brought fresh information regarding Nolfi and Batna.
target: Ita dum Lumian cogitabat ulteriora agere, ut omnia ante caerimoniam orationis maritimae in initio Novembris explanaret, Eques Gladii novas de Nolfi et Batna attulit.

source: His face maintaining a pale-white hue, he spoke to Lumian, “I’ve identified a suspect involved in the kidnapping of the two targets. Should I handle it alone, or shall we proceed together?”
target: Vultus eius, pallide albus manens, ad Lumian locutus est: “Suspectum deprehendi qui in abductione duorum versabatur. Solus agere debeam, an simul procedamus?”
